title: LST: streamed linear-space cutoff shift testing

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), LST in proof.md uses k=n+4 tests per candidate, a global cap 48N, and the specified streamed linear-size reversible arithmetic. It recovers the entire s with unconditional probability >5/6. On every branch its total charged work is O(N n log2(n+2)), hence the uniform envelope B_T(n)=2^n n log2 n for n>=2; its exact growth index is 1. All constants are absolute; all four resource bounds and the clean-input tolerance hold jointly for this single configuration.

For every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), LST in proof.md uses k=n+4 tests per candidate, a global cap 48N, and the specified streamed linear-size reversible arithmetic. It recovers the entire s with unconditional probability >5/6. On every branch its peak allocated classical space is O(n) bits; its envelope B_C(n)=n has exact growth index 0. All constants are absolute; all four resource bounds and the clean-input tolerance hold jointly for this single configuration.

For every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), LST in proof.md uses k=n+4 tests per candidate, a global cap 48N, and the specified streamed linear-size reversible arithmetic. It recovers the entire s with unconditional probability >5/6. On every branch its peak allocated quantum space is O(n) qubits; its envelope B_Q(n)=n has exact growth index 0. All constants are absolute; all four resource bounds and the clean-input tolerance hold jointly for this single configuration.

For every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), LST in proof.md uses k=n+4 tests per candidate, a global cap 48N, and the specified streamed linear-size reversible arithmetic. It recovers the entire s with unconditional probability >5/6. On every branch the number of acquired source copies is at most 48N, including failures and discarded copies; its uniform envelope B_samples(n)=2^n has exact growth index 1. All constants are absolute; all four resource bounds and the clean-input tolerance hold jointly for this single configuration.

For every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), LST in proof.md uses k=n+4 tests per candidate, a global cap 48N, and the specified streamed linear-size reversible arithmetic. It recovers the entire s with unconditional probability >5/6. The guaranteed malformed fraction is epsilon(n)=0: all acquired copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise all four resource bounds and success >5/6 hold jointly. No positive corruption tolerance or impossibility of such tolerance is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
